contents.reason: This comparison depends on the unscaffolded relative Mayer--Vietoris triad formalism, so it cannot be included honestly without enlarging the page beyond its designed absolute-chain route.

contents.name: Chapter 14, Section 6 "The homology of colimits"
contents.reason: The relevant future use is passage from finite skeleta to a CW complex; general colimit axioms are not a prerequisite for the finite-support subdivision proof developed on this page.

contents.name: Chapter 16, Section 3 "Proofs of the theorems"

contents.name: Theorem: gamma: Gamma X to X is a weak equivalence
